svg.title: From Interactive Checks to a Real Test Suite
svg.desc: A three-row stack showing the shift this lesson makes. Row 1: every earlier lesson ran AppTest interactively, one script at a time, in a scratch bash session. Row 2: test_app.py wraps the identical checks as real pytest functions, each with a plain assert. Row 3: one pytest command runs all of them at once, reporting a real pass or fail per test -- confirmed here with 3 passing tests and one deliberately broken test shown failing for real before its removal.
svg.text: From Interactive Checks to a Real Test Suite
Every earlier lesson: AppTest run interactively, one script at a time
test_app.py: the same checks, as real pytest functions with assert
pytest test_app.py -- one command, every test, a real pass/fail per test
Confirmed for real: 3 tests passing, and one deliberately wrong assertion shown failing with a
genuine pytest AssertionError before it was removed.
